name: Phone desktop (no root)
author: AndroUnderTheHood
description: Ubuntu 24.04 + KDE Plasma on the phone WITHOUT root: runs under proot as Android's shell user (ADB, or SSH with Shizuku), on a virtual display, reachable with RustDesk. Install (online or from the same offline bundle as Phone desktop), start/stop, status, RustDesk password and port, uninstall, with a live terminal and progress. Includes Firefox and, when its .deb is in the files folder, ElixirOffice.
